phrase.zh: 看清因由，也是理解自己。
phrase.en: Understanding causes can clarify the self.

visual.zh: 斯宾诺莎的生成肖像、透镜与相连曲线将“看清”化为思想隐喻。透镜与人物并置并不意味着他的哲学可以由光学实验直接证明。
visual.en: A generated Spinoza portrait, lenses and connected curves turn clarity of sight into a philosophical metaphor. Their juxtaposition does not imply that optics proves his philosophy.

background.zh: 《斯坦福哲学百科全书》介绍《伦理学》如何从定义、公理和命题逐步建立论证，把关于自然的理解与人的情感、理性及幸福联系起来。斯宾诺莎于 1677 年去世，留下尚未完成的《政治论》。画面强调理解原因的姿态，而非一句万能人生格言。
background.en: The Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy describes the Ethics developing arguments through definitions, axioms and propositions, linking nature with emotion, reason and well-being. Spinoza died in 1677 leaving the Political Treatise unfinished. The image emphasizes inquiry into causes, rather than a universal life slogan.
